chapter_seo_title: Desolate Era Ch. 46: Ji Ning's Three Stomps Destroy a City Gate
chapter_meta_description: Ji Ning arrives at the Riverside Tribe seeking vengeance. Three stomps bring down the city wall. The Xiantian elders of the tribe are powerless before the future heir of the Western Prefecture.
og_title: Three Stomps. One City Wall. Absolute Domination.
og_description: Ji Ning declares war on the Riverside Tribe by crushing their gate with raw Fiendgod power. The elders panic. Jiang He is dragged out like a chicken.
twitter_title: When words fail, stomp the wall down. Ji Ning isn't here to negotiate.
twitter_description: Ji Ning arrives at Riverside City, roars Jiang He's name, and stomps the gate into rubble. The Xiantian elders realize they're dealing with the future Prefectural Lord.
